entries.title: Driving Emotion Type-S

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 with an owned international PS2 copy for higher internal resolution and modern display options.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 presentation with optional emulator-side improvements.

primary.why: The international PS2 releases are the best version because they retain the same platform while revising the criticized handling and adding content compared with the Japanese launch release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the North American or European PS2 disc on compatible hardware, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or modern rerelease was identified.
